messages:
deploy-bot: deploy complete: rollout v2.13.0 -> canary-usw2. starting post-deploy smoke tests (synthetic + kvprobe). see dashboard https://dash.redwood.ai/r/rollouts/1758201234 :white_check_mark:
jen: seeing synth failures on /embed route, p95 jumped from 120ms -> 680ms around 1758201200. :eyes:
ev an: can you paste the probe log?
jen: logs: ```
HTTP 200  /embed  latency=680ms  trace_id=tx-9a8b
WARN kvcache miss prefix_id=embed:short
```
jen: also noticed 5xxs in gen-route trace sampler (small count)
lucas: hmm metrics show KV warmup rate steady. any burst in batch sizes?
siva: traffic to canary is only 3% — curious this shows up so fast. maybe kernel change in runtime selection with v2.13 quant profile?
anika: release notes for v2.13 mention "kernel-selection tweaks and quant-profile default change for embed models" — might be related. https://internal.redwood.ai/releases/2.13.0
evan: recommend PAUSE rollout and pin traffic back to v2.12.9 for embed route until we triage.
jen: +1. how to pin quickly?
lucas: you can run: ```redwoodctl routing set --route /embed --version v2.12.9 --percent 100 --reason "postdeploy embed p95 spike"```
jen: running that now, will report back. :running_woman:
jen: pinned /embed -> v2.12.9, rolled canary back for that route. canary overall still has v2.13 for other routes.
deploy-bot: routing change applied by jen at 1758201272. audit id r-audit-7782.
jen: after pin, p95 dropped to 140ms in ~60s. looks much better. :thumbsup:
siva: great. do we want a full rollback of v2.13 or keep partial pin?
evan: hold on full rollback. let's run a focused regression on the quant/kernel change with an infra/serving engineer. If it's isolated to embed variant we can patch config.
lucas: I'll add an entry to the release notes pointing to the pin and observed metrics, and open a followup RFC for kernel selection safety gates.
anika: I'll loop in @infra-team and @serving-optim so they can look at kernel selection heuristics.
jen: action items: jen monitor p95 for 15m, evan collect perf traces and kvcache stats, lucas update notes, anika ping infra. If no regression fix in 30m we consider full rollback.
evan: gathered trace link: https://traces.redwood.ai/tx-9a8b. attaching heatmap in ticket.
jen: 10m check-in scheduled. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: thread flagged as "hold" by jen at 1758201301.
